newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four children killed by train in Russian Far East.
newsitem.headline: Four children killed by train in Russian Far East.

text.p: Four children aged between nine and 15 died when they were hit by a train near the Russian Far East city of Nakhodka, Interfax news agency quoted local civil defence officials as saying on Tuesday.
Officials said the children had not noticed two trains approaching while they were on the railroad tracks. They managed to avoid one train, but were immediately run over by the other.
Three died on the spot and the fourth died in hospital.
